assertions.assertion: Output registers health checks using builder.Services.AddHealthChecks()
Output adds AddDbContextCheck<ConfigurationDbContext> and AddDbContextCheck<PersistedGrantDbContext> tagged with a 'ready' tag
Output maps /health/live with a Predicate that runs no checks (_ => false) so the liveness probe only confirms IdentityServer middleware is running
assertions.rationale: Liveness uses a 'self' check tagged 'live' with Predicate c.Tags.Contains("live") rather than Predicate = _ => false.

assertions.assertion: Output maps /health/ready with a Predicate filtering on the 'ready' tag
assertions.rationale: /health/ready maps with Predicate filtering on 'ready' tag.

assertions.assertion: Output does NOT rely on custom IHealthCheck classes that invoke the discovery/JWKS endpoint handlers via IEnumerable<Hosting.Endpoint>
assertions.rationale: No custom IHealthCheck invoking discovery/JWKS endpoint handlers.
